title: Per-prompt attribution playbook for split rollouts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Build a reproducible playbook and lightweight infra for attributing quality regressions to individual eval prompts (or prompt clusters) during split and canary rollouts, enabling fast, explainable rollback decisions and human-in-the-loop adjudication. Scope includes: (1) per-prompt delta scoring and attribution heuristics, (2) fuzzy-match prompt clustering for sparse golden coverage, (3) surge sampling + enrichment for low-frequency probes, (4) an explainable alert format consumed by Console rollouts and Pager duty flows, and (5) a small adjudication UI for product/SEs to mark false-positives and curate golden sets. Out of scope: full model retraining or automated model patching. Success criteria: a) detect regressions that impact >=1% of production requests (or any critical-golden prompt) with <=5% false-positive rate on our internal simulated regressions; b) mean time to actionable alert <= 10 minutes after divergence; c) human adjudication completes within 24 hours for flagged canaries; d) automated canary weight rollback decision surfaced with clear per-prompt attribution lines in Console. Acceptance tests: synthetic regressions injected into shadow traffic, end-to-end alert -> adjudication -> rollback simulation passes in staging.
updates: 2025-02-14 — Initial scoping and kickoff. Mapped stakeholders: Product (Priya Rao), Observability (Liam Park), Console UX (Ana Rivera). Logged rollout-quality project as parent.
2025-02-15 — Prototyped per-prompt delta metric (token-level BLEU-like + semantic similarity) in eval harness. Early results show high signal for hallucination regressions but noisy for style shifts.
2025-02-16 — Decided on hybrid attribution: primary signal = weighted delta score per golden prompt; secondary = cluster-level density change using fuzzy hashing (MinHash) to group paraphrases.
2025-02-17 — Tradeoff: strict gating with low latency vs. richer explainability. We will emit both a fast scalar gate for autorevert and an explainable report attached to the alert for human review.

2025-02-18 — Built surge-sampling plan: when a prompt cluster triggers >N deviations, increase sampling of that cluster from production (1k extra infra probes over 30m) to stabilize estimates. Added quota guardrails to avoid cost blowups.

2025-02-19 — Design review with Console team. UI contract agreed: alert includes top 5 attributable prompts, delta score, traffic share, and example input/outputs. Console will show a time-series with cohort splits and allow "escalate to HITL" or "mark false-positive".

2025-02-20 — Implemented MVP exporter that emits explainable-alert protobuf to rollout conductor. End-to-end smoke in staging with a canned regression PR: red/green canary weight simulation behaves as expected. Open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4231. Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RQ/Per-Prompt+Attribution+Playbook.
Pending — Add automated adjudication rules, integrate cost meter for surge sampling, and finalize alert thresholds with product.
